//: Azure Static Web Apps serve EVERY file under the app location, and the site
is public whatever the repo's visibility. Without these rules the publish
script and any .md in the repo are readable by anyone with the URL.
Only the prototypes, their assets and the landing page should be reachable.
The workflow file holds no secret — it references ${{ secrets.NAME }}, and the
value lives in GitHub Actions secrets, never in the repo. It is blocked anyway:
there is no reason for the site to serve its own build configuration.
